subject: Minecraft Java 1.8.8 pressure-plate redstone semantics

base.weak_power: current redstone strength on every queried side
base.strong_power: current redstone strength only toward EnumFacing.UP, corresponding to the supporting block below
base.activation: entity collision/occupancy causes the plate to compute its own redstone strength

inference_boundary: This evidence supports a direct pressure-plate-to-support strong-power edge only.
It does not establish arbitrary opaque-solid conduction beyond the directly powered support.
Runtime qualification remains separate from player comprehension and qualitative judgment.
